intent: Upgrade the Foshan viewer into Stage 2: a map-first digital-city core with fast 2D/3D switching, faithful roads/water layout, GPU city buildings and a dedicated high-detail landmark layer.
constraints: Default map usage requires no paid API key.
The existing v1 Three.js viewer remains available as a legacy regression path.
Ordinary city buildings must no longer be generated via per-building Three.js ExtrudeGeometry in the Stage 2 entrypoint.
Road and water geometry must come from real open map vector data, not hand-authored approximations.
High-detail landmark assets may only be bundled when redistribution rights are verified.
WGS84/Web Mercator is the common geographic reference for Stage 2 layers.
nonGoals: Pixel-copying Google Maps, Amap, or their proprietary visual styles.
Claiming planned landmark model slots are finished photogrammetry assets.
Replacing surveyed photogrammetry where no open or licensed source exists.

requirements.statement: The default entrypoint uses MapLibre GL JS and supports interactive 2D and 3D modes in the same geographic camera.
Stage 2 ordinary buildings are rendered with vector-tile fill/fill-extrusion and not with per-building Three.js ExtrudeGeometry.
The 2D map includes real road, water and label geometry from an open production basemap; 3D mode retains the same geographic layout.
Overture buildings and Terrarium DEM are layered on the map for 3D buildings and terrain.
A MapLibre custom layer backed by Three.js exists for licensed high-detail landmark GLB assets and reads the audited landmark manifest.
At least ten Foshan landmark precision targets are exposed in Stage 2 navigation while unfinished model assets remain explicitly marked as planned.
The v1 Three.js application remains buildable and accessible at legacy.html.

checks.description: Static Stage 2 and legacy regression checks pass.
OpenFreeMap, Overture and terrain public data endpoints are reachable and expose transportation/water layers.
Production browser smoke reaches appReady=true with mapEngine=maplibre, buildingSource=ready and a rendered screenshot.
